page_title: RSO 4-3 GET | Real Sociedad v Getafe 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+2' 4 - 3 It's a goal! Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 4:3.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
88' 4 - 2 Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the middle of the goal.
88' Juan Pulido sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
88' Real Sociedad score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
88' The attendance is 29568.
87' A lofted cross from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
86' A pass by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
83' What a chance to score from the free kick by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad). He unleashed a sharp shot that sailed just wide of the right post.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Igor Zubeldia.
78' The game has come to an end for Carles Alena. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Choco Lozano (Getafe).
78' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) replacing Jaime Mata.
74' Real Sociedad hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
72' A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
69' That will be all from Ander Barrenetxea who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) replaces Jose Angel Carmona.
68' Here is a change. Djene is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Mason Greenwood (Getafe).
66' 3 - 2 Goal! A defensive error presents Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) with a great chance and he takes advantage of it by heading the ball into the back of the net. 3:2.
65' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
64' Real Sociedad have been awarded a free kick.
61' 2 - 2 Goal! David Soria gets a hand on the penalty from Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
61' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
60' A player from Getafe takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Real Sociedad!
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
58' Substitution. Umar Sadiq makes way for Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
58' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) replaces Benat Turrientes.
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch so that Urko Gonzalez can be given a rest.
56' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
53' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
50' Urko Gonzalez (Real Sociedad) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Damian Suarez (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
47' One of the players from Real Sociedad times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Substitution. Borja Mayoral did his best and is replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Getafe).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+8' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45+5' 1 - 2 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Alex Remiro.
45+4' The referee shows a yellow card to Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
45+4' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+3' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+1' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
42' Jaime Mata (Getafe) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
39' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Carles Alena (Getafe) does well to meet a cross inside the box and plants a header into the top right corner.
39' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
38' Getafe are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
34' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but David Soria punches the ball away.
32' The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
32' A pass by Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
31' One of the Real Sociedad players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
29' Jaime Mata (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
28' Damian Suarez (Getafe) produces a long-range pass.
26' The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
24' Chance! Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
21' Good movement by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Rico (Getafe) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
18' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
17' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
15' Chance! Djene (Getafe) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.

12' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Pulido with no other option than to blow for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.
10' Jaime Mata (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
9' Djene (Getafe) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Great teamplay by Real Sociedad as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' What a sweet pass and great technique by Carles Alena (Getafe) as he finds his teammate with a precise lofted through ball.
4' Getafe are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
2' 1 - 0 Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the left post. What a beautiful shot.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will officiate today.
